svg.text: Stayra — End-to-End Visual Data Flow Diagram (DFD Level 1)
Complete Operational Lifecycle: Discover → Tenancy → Monthly Rent → Complaints → SLA Credit → Reputation

g.text: Resident inputs budget, sharing type, curfew, and location
AI Intent Extraction & PostGIS Spatial Query
Displays verified photos, living reputation score, and food menu
Resident attaches Stayra Resident ID & KYC status
Bed status toggled to RESERVED; contract drafted
Bed status moves to OCCUPIED; tenancy status = ACTIVE
Automated Monthly Billing Cron (1st of Mo)
Loads Agreed Rent + Metered Electricity + Food charges
Subtracts unapplied service credits directly from total
Razorpay webhook reconciles ledger to 0 balance
e.g., "WiFi down on 3rd floor since yesterday afternoon"
Detects category: WIFI, Severity: MEDIUM, SLA: 24 Hours
Push alerts sent to staff; SLA countdown timer starts
Scans all open tickets against configured sla_target_time
Staff Resolves Ticket with Photo Evidence
Resident confirms fix or rejects within 24 hours
Speed, Cleanliness, Staff Courtesy, and Problem Solved
Adherence % updated; directly feeds back into Stage 1 ranking
• Balance is never a single mutable column
• Every transaction logs paired Debit & Credit
• Owners configure policy upfront in agreement
• Credits automatically subtract from next bill
• Preserves verified KYC and payment reliability
• Data minimization: Past owners have zero
access to future tenancies or private reviews
